label: sparse late-original/delimiter feature with diffuse token-history dependence (unexplained)
explanation: Very sparse (0.027% of steps). Fires only at t>=3, mostly in the late original phase and at the <DEL> step (37% of mass), plus the first copy step; essentially never later in the copy phase or at t<3. Enriched for current inputs p/s/r/a/<DEL>, previous inputs 3/e/x/h, tokens two back 3/h/d, and first tokens a/p/k/b/w/q, but no conjunction of these reaches precision above about 3%: the same contexts are overwhelmingly inactive. It looks like a distributed hidden-state combination rather than a nameable token or position pattern. The recorded predicate is a reference conjunction (dev F1 0.05, mass recall 0.44), not an explanation.
